revision_resolution_method: Hugging Face public API GET /api/datasets/ICVL-BGU/ICVL_HS_2016 -> field 'sha' (the commit that 'main' currently points at); the same SHA was then used to fetch the file tree via GET /api/datasets/ICVL-BGU/ICVL_HS_2016/tree/<sha>?recursive=1
gating_note: The repository is public but gated ('auto'). Repository metadata and the file tree are readable anonymously; the file BLOBS are not. An unauthenticated HEAD on /datasets/ICVL-BGU/ICVL_HS_2016/resolve/<sha>/mat/<file>.mat returns HTTP 401. After the user accepted the gate and logged in (user: yunorz), the same request succeeded and the full mat/* set was downloaded.

per_file_digest_availability.evidence: The 64-asterisk sequence is present in the RAW HTTP response bytes, before any local write. Control test: the same endpoint returns real 64-hex oids for the public non-gated datasets princeton-nlp/SWE-bench and openai/gsm8k. With an Authorization header the same gated endpoint returns real 64-hex oids.
per_file_digest_availability.consequence: The file list and file sizes are authoritative either way, but the repository-declared SHA256 per file is only present on AUTHENTICATED requests. An anonymous tree capture therefore yields a manifest whose remote-digest comparison is vacuously true. fetch_pinned_tree.py refuses to write a tree whose digests are redacted, and verify_against_remote_oids.py refuses to report a pass in that state.
per_file_digest_availability.resolved_outcome: After authentication the pinned tree was re-captured with 606 of 606 LFS entries carrying real digests, and all 202 mat/* files matched the repository's own declared oid.

pinning_rule: Every download for this work package must pass --revision with the full SHA above. The moving ref 'main' must never be used for the formal download.
